subject: General Science

questions.q: Which of the following statements is true about gravitational force of the Earth?
options: It acts away from the centre of Earth.
It depends on the mass of the object.
It is independent of distance from Earth’s centre.
questions.explain: Gravitational force depends on the mass of the objects involved. The formula for gravitational force is $F = G\frac{m_1 m_2}{r^2}$, which clearly shows its dependence on the mass of the object.
